biography.plain_text: Sheikh Nasser Ahmed Ali A. Al Thani is a Qatari royal-family member who invested in hotels in Marmaris, Turkey. Through his Al Maselah company, he acquired the Munamar hotel in 2010. He later added the nearby Kontes Beach hotel, extending his investment activity within the Turkish resort's commercial property market.

long_biography.plain_text:
Nasser Ahmed Ali A. Al Thani took a personal role in his Turkish property purchases. After seeing photographs of the Munamar hotel and its surroundings, he visited the property, negotiated with its owners and attended the local land registry. The acquisition included a seafront site in İçmeler, an established holiday district.

For the hotel's operation, he turned to a consortium of local businesspeople. Güney Yıldızı Otelcilik brought together hotel owners, operators and a meat-business proprietor. It leased the property before the 2012 summer season, separating Al Thani's ownership of the building from the management of its tourist accommodation.
